```{r}
#visualizing the strongest negative correlation.

combined_data
```

```{r}
#we find 1 cgs, not 1 patients, we have 176 pateints to check that 1 cgs
#plot for 1 cg


png( #save png
  "figures/BCL7A_cg27193813_methylation_expression.png",
  width = 1800,
  height = 1400,
  res = 300
)

fit1 <- lm( #linear regression model
  BCL7A_expression ~ cg27193813,
  data = combined_data
) 

plot(
  combined_data$cg27193813,
  combined_data$BCL7A_expression,
  pch = 16,
  xlab = "BCL7A methylation (cg27193813)",
  ylab = "BCL7A expression",
  main = "BCL7A methylation vs BCL7A expression"
)

abline(
  fit1,
  lty = 3,
  lwd = 2
)

dev.off() #finish and save
```
